author: Tiffany Wiley
title: Fiber line damage disrupts wireless service across several other northeast Louisiana parishes - NewsBreak
text:
By Tiffany Wiley ,
2 hours ago
CALDWELL PARISH, La. ( KTVE/KARD ) — Residents in several northeast Louisiana parishes may be experiencing wireless service interruptions following a fiber line cut, according to Caldwell Parish 911 officials.
Emergency communications leaders said they were notified of a fiber cut affecting wireless coverage in Caldwell, LaSalle, Franklin and Catahoula parishes. Multiple service providers have reported impacts from the outage.
Officials said the affected providers are aware of the issue and have crews working to locate the damaged fiber line and complete repairs as quickly as possible. No timeline for full service restoration has been announced.
Residents who are experiencing connectivity issues are encouraged to monitor updates from their wireless service providers as repair efforts continue.
